hypothesis: A 24 m lane spacing safely isolates 16 simultaneous G1-ball Isaac courses, including balls deflected more than 4 m, and preserves independently measured course outcomes.
comparison: New one-G1/one-ball frozen SONIC parent evidence for even lanes 0-14 using the exact current runner source, course seed and assets; old v274 reports are only historical context because their runner source differs. Odd lanes are not equivalence claims.
required_audits: Same source/asset/SONIC; report and raw traces authenticated; all lane centers exact multiples of 24 m; maximum lane excursion <10 m, inter-ball distance >1 m and inter-robot distance >2 m; no collision body contamination.
equivalence_gate: For each of eight compared even lanes, first-contact presence/body set agree, first-contact frame differs by at most one, minimum pelvis difference <=0.02 m, and 60-frame ball displacement x/y difference <=0.10 m. If any fails, batched data is not training-authorized.
